# Shipping Policy

## Dispatch

Orders placed before 14:00 are dispatched the same working day. Orders placed
after that cut-off are dispatched the next working day.

## Carriers

Acme Widgets uses a single carrier for all domestic deliveries. The carrier is
not named in this documentation, which makes carrier identity a deliberate gap
for the unanswerable fixture case.
